bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Wednesday) the track is rated a good 4 but with rain forecast this evening there's the chance of a downgrade. Speedy former Victorian mare CLIFFS HANGER draws to advantage and any positive market moves must be respected at her local debut. IT'S KAOS draws wide but has been trialling well and the 3kg claim for Kayla Johnston helps. The debutante VEGA FIVE has placed in both spaced trials - check for support. LUMINOUS GIRL is building toward a win having placed at her past couple.

raceTips.comment: VEGA FIRE debuts. Given the two trials, he chased hard despite being very raw in his first heat and over the 1000m in his latest, he cruised through the line under a hold. He may be looking for further but I think he’s talented and he’ll be strong late. IT’S KAOS returns. She failed her figure in her first two runs but did have excuses. She impressed in her latest trial at the Sunshine Coast and the 800m kick off will suit. LOVE AND PAIN was nailed right on the line when kicking off for the new stable over 870m at Toowoomba. Fitter, the 800m looks ideal and the low draw is a big plus. CLIFFS HANGER kicks off for the new stable. She’s shown good early speed but has failed to see out the 1000m. The shorter trip will suit and from the inside draw, she’ll take catching.

bestBets.overview: KING EMPEROR charged home to just miss on debut before sitting too far back at his second attempt. The rise to 1666m looks suitable now and he must be given another chance. BRASS BAND is starting to rack up the convictions but has been game in the placings at his past four attempts. Expect I SAY I SAY to press forward from his wide draw and be in it for a long way. AMAZARA improved sharply to place second up, then made good ground from the back in a race controlled by the leader last time.

raceTips.comment: KING EMPEROR charged late to miss by the barest of margins on debut at the Sunshine Coast but was squeezed out after jumping at his second outing and didn’t have a lot of luck from there. The rise in trip looks ideal and the blinkers go on. BRASS BAND has been the runner up his past three starts and looks nearing a win. Hard fit, he suited here at the mile and will be strong at the finish. AMAZARA has been placed at her past two starts. She got a long way back from the wide gate last time but closed off strongly late. With a senior rider aboard and the inside draw, she’ll be right in this. I SAY I SAY has felt the pinch late at his past couple of runs. The blinkers come off, which should help him to relax, and he does perform well here at Ipswich.

bestBets.overview: KERKORIAN sustained a long run to score at the Sunny Coast, then had support and wasn't far away when rising to metro company last time. He looks nicely placed back in grade here. CHASSAGNE should be ready to show more out to 2150m at her third run this term. MAKAMAE has proved costly having been a beaten fave at her past three outings but maps to get all the favours. LAUNCHER hasn't been far away of late and may now be looking for this longer journey.

raceTips.comment: CHASSAGNE has failed to figure in two runs back but will certainly appreciate the drop in grade. She holds a strong record over this journey and at peak fitness, she can improve. BIG TICKET BOY comes off dominant four length victory over 1800m at the Sunshine Coast. He’s proven at this trip, he draws low but he does rise 5.5kgs. KERKORIAN won well at the Sunshine Coast two runs back but just found them a touch too good when stepping up to metro company last time. Back in grade, he can bounce back. MAKAMAE is on the quick back up after finishing second at the Sunshine Coast on Sunday. She’s hard fit and the rise in journey suits.

bestBets.overview: MASHEAN found one better at the short quote fresh before leading throughout for a dominant second up win. This looks a suitable progression and she should take plenty of catching again. COINCIDE finished off strongly to score over 1100m here last time and is not unsuited back in trip. Not much separated BEFORE ANYONE ELSE and CRYPTO MISS in metro company last start. Both draw kindly and are capable of improving sharply back in class. I AM GONE is going well but draws poorly.

raceTips.comment: BEFORE ANYONE ELSE weakened late last start over the 1000m in much stronger company. Back sharply in grade, she boasts a terrific record at this track and trip and the blinkers go on. I AM GOOD has won two of her three starts this campaign and I think she’ll continue to progress. The 800m suits but she will need luck from the wide gate. MASHEAN comes off a dominant win over 800m at Gatton and from the low draw, she’ll be in it for a long way. CRYPTO MISS weakened late when resuming over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Fitter, she drops back in grade and I think the 800m dash will suit.

bestBets.overview: LUCONI was specked at healthy odds and closed well to just miss over 1400m fresh. He'll only be improved, the rise in trip suits and he's placed at two of three second up runs. DIVIL A BIT led throughout to clear maiden ranks over this route, then gave another good sight over 1800m at the Gold Coast. FLYING BAT found little in the run home last time but is entitled to another chance on his previous consistent form. CLASSIQUE GAL was a noted drifter in betting when failing to finish off at Doomben but was dominant here the start prior.

raceTips.comment: LUCONI closed off strongly to finish only a neck away in second when resuming over 1400m. Fitter the rise in trip suits and he gets James Orman to steer from a good draw. YUKANUMA didn’t have a lot of luck last start over 2000m here. Freshened, he’s well suited dropping back in trip and gets in nicely with the claim. HAZEY HILL has been freshened since scoring over the mile at Gatton. He’s unbeaten in two runs over this track and trip and if the team have him fit and ready, he’ll be hard to beat again. CLASSIQUE GAL is hard fit and racing well. She scored a commanding five length win over this track and trip two runs back and she’ll be doing her best work late once again.

bestBets.overview: BOLSHEVIC ROAD wasn't far away at massive odds at Doomben last start. He's yet to miss the quinella from three tries this route and it may be a good lead that he's been scratched from the preceding event in preference to this. The on-pacer HOLY FLASH is bursting for another win having placed at his past four outings. DON'TCHA THINK has the outside alley to overcome but has been trialling well and has only missed the quinella once in five fresh runs. ROYAL GLADIATOR found little in the run home two starts ago but has been game in defeat either side of that.

raceTips.comment: HOLY FLASH is hard fit and racing well. He’s ideally suited here at this trip and will appreciate some weight relief as Sophie Wilcock takes off 3kgs. SAVUER returns to the races. She’s yet to fire in three first up appearances but looks ideally suited kicking off here at 1350m and she draws to get the right run. DON’TCHA THINK resumes. He races well fresh and has been readied for this with two recent trials. He will need luck from the wide gate but gets leading rider Ben Thompson aboard. ROYAL GLADIATOR has been the runner up in two of his past three starts. He’s hard fit and can make his presence felt.

bestBets.overview: FORGOTTEN SPIRIT loomed to win and was only nailed late in metro company when resuming for the new yard. She should get a gun run in transit from the kind draw and looks very well placed back in grade. TAM NA GHAR found form quickly in her initial prep and placed in the latest of two lead-in trials. STARVECCHIO just held position at the short quote fresh but will be better for the hitout and scored well on debut. STARLIGHTNING scored a tough on-pace win at his first attempt, then battled away soundly after taking a sit next try.

raceTips.comment: FORGOTTEN SPIRIT turned out some strong performances last campaign against quality opposition and is sure to find this easier.  Denied by only the barest of margins when resuming over 1000m at Eagle Farm, she will have taken improvement from the run and the low draw will see her afforded every chance. TASMAN BAY proved far too good when resuming over 1000m. A very progressive galloper, she strips fitter and the rise in trip will suit. STARVECCHIO won well over on debut before a break but she didn’t have anything go right for her when making her return at the Sunshine Coast. The step to 1200m suits and she draws to get the right run. STARLIGHTNING was a winner on debut over 1015m at the Gold Coast but just wanted to lay in last time at the Sunshine Coast. The blinkers go on and from the inside draw, he’ll take catching.
